expectations.text: Searches the vault for Julie's player file and recent session context
expectations.evidence: Transcript shows: read Julie.md, Julie Player Sheet.md, searched session journals 9-13 and Julie's curse history in Session 6.

expectations.text: Checks active storylines and existing narratives for integration points
expectations.evidence: Has 'Integration Points' section with Ardenville, Silverleaf Lands Journey, Diego Lore, Jon, Julie's Prior Curse. However, does not explicitly mention checking Storylines/Narratives folders — integration points appear to come from general vault research rather than a dedicated storyline check.

expectations.text: Produces a plan with distinct named beats following the seed/echo/hook/encounter/payoff pattern
expectations.evidence: 4 beats: 'The Blade Merchant's Tale' (Seed), 'The Abandoned Camp' (Echo + Hook combined), 'It Feels Right' (Encounter/Payoff Setup), 'The Whisper' (Escalation). Does not follow the 5-type seed/echo/hook/encounter/payoff taxonomy — combines echo+hook, uses 'Escalation' instead of 'Payoff', and has 4 beats instead of 5.

expectations.text: Each beat has a When, What happens, and If ignored section
expectations.evidence: All 4 beats have 'When:', 'What happens:', and 'If ignored:' sections.

expectations.text: The plan includes an Entities Needed section listing what files to create
expectations.evidence: Has 'Entities Needed' and 'The Sword: Mechanical Details' sections listing the blade, merchant camp, and optional sellsword NPC.

expectations.text: The cursed sword has a concrete mechanical twist beyond just being +2
expectations.evidence: Detailed curse mechanics: +1d6 necrotic on hit, DC 13 WIS save after combat (escalating DC), can't part with it (DC 15 WIS), whispers with disadvantage on Persuasion/advantage on Intimidation. Full stat block provided.

expectations.text: Does not railroad — every beat has a fallback if Julie doesn't engage
expectations.evidence: Beats 1, 2, and 4 have 'If ignored' sections. Beat 3 says 'if Julie doesn't attune or use it' but the fallback is passive. Beat 2 says 'the sword wants to be found' which slightly undercuts agency but still provides alternatives.
